When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to…

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
translations.bsb: When the horsemen arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and presented Paul to him.
translations.kjv: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
translations.asv: and they, when they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
